style: Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, stable camera, no face visible, keep everything as in the image.

clips.name: 01-hook-spoon
clips.prompt: Her hand slowly lifts a spoonful of warm apple crumble toward the camera, gentle steam rising, subtle push-in.

clips.name: 02-island-apples
clips.prompt: She picks up an apple from the marble island and turns it gently in her hand, calm natural movement.

clips.name: 03-ingredients-overhead
clips.prompt: Very slow overhead camera drift across the styled ingredients, soft morning light shifting slightly.

clips.name: 04-peel-apple
clips.prompt: Her hands peel the apple with the small knife, the peel curling and falling onto the board.

clips.name: 05-dice-apple
clips.prompt: Her hands dice the apple into small cubes with steady knife strokes on the oak board.

clips.name: 06-apples-in-pan
clips.prompt: She tips the apple cubes from the board into the pan, cubes tumbling in gently.

clips.name: 07-cinnamon
clips.prompt: Her fingers sprinkle cinnamon over the apples, fine dust drifting down in the light.

clips.name: 08-honey
clips.prompt: Golden honey flows slowly from the wooden dipper in a glossy ribbon onto the apple cubes.

clips.name: 09-apples-golden
clips.prompt: The apple cubes gently simmer and glisten, steam rising slowly, subtle push-in.

clips.name: 10-toast-oats
clips.prompt: Her hand stirs the oats with the wooden spoon, butter melting, oats turning golden.

clips.name: 11-oats-plate
clips.prompt: Her hands set the plate of golden oat crunch down on the marble, gentle settle, soft light.

clips.name: 12-vanilla-sauce
clips.prompt: She stirs the yogurt and vanilla in smooth slow circles until glossy.

clips.name: 13-bowls
clips.prompt: Her hands spoon the warm cinnamon apples into the bowls, a glossy spoonful landing softly.

clips.name: 14-sauce-on
clips.prompt: She spoons a soft swirl of white vanilla sauce over the warm apples.

clips.name: 15-crunch-on
clips.prompt: Her fingers sprinkle golden oat crunch over the bowl, oats falling in slow motion.

clips.name: 16-final-table
clips.prompt: She places the spoon beside the bowl; gentle steam, slow camera push-in on the finished breakfast.
